why: The control for a game whose first score comes late by design: the race scores only at the finish line, and with the bot pace a new player found fair (0.72) no bot finished inside the check's fixed window, so measure 12 failed and the build made its bots faster to pass (PA10: "A botPace of 0.72 made the bots fair game for a new player, but it failed check 12 ... That is why it is 0.8"). Fair play's pages now play on to the game's own round while nothing has scored (fair-check.mjs playOnFor), so the fair pace passes.
